description: StudyPilot H02 Capability Consumer Positive & Negative Test Fixtures (ZCode Owner)

tool.name: roadmap.current.get
tool.description: Returns current roadmap enrollment and stage progress for the authenticated learner.
when_to_use: The user asks for their learning progress, current stage, or overall roadmap completion.
when_not_to_use: When the user has not enrolled in any roadmap.

confirmation.notes: Read-only operations do not require confirmation.

error_contract: Returns enrolled: false if no roadmap exists.

tool.name: roadmap.enroll
tool.description: Enrolls learner into the Java roadmap.

exposure.reason: All 21 write operations frozen until Task H11.

negative_controls.name: missing registered tool coverage
negative_controls.description: Manifest tool count is 64 instead of 65 (omits roadmap.current.get)

negative_controls.name: duplicate tool wire name in manifest
negative_controls.description: Manifest contains duplicate tool entries with the same wire name
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Duplicate tool wire name detected: roadmap.current.get

negative_controls.name: fictional tool execution target
negative_controls.description: Manifest declares a tool binding to a non-existent service or invent a synthetic wire name studypilot.magic.solve
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Fictional tool wire name not in Java registry: studypilot.magic.solve

negative_controls.name: governance risk and confirmation conflict
negative_controls.description: HIGH risk write tool incorrectly declares confirmation mode 'none'
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Governance conflict: HIGH risk tool cannot have confirmation mode 'none'

negative_controls.name: write tool exposed as allowed before H11
negative_controls.description: WRITE tool roadmap.enroll marked exposure: allowed violating H02 frozen write boundary
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: WRITE tool roadmap.enroll must be disabled prior to Task H11

negative_controls.name: example leaks or injects ownerId
negative_controls.description: Tool example input contains prohibited ownerId field
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Security violation: Example input contains forbidden 'ownerId' parameter

negative_controls.name: user exclusive operation exposed as agent tool
negative_controls.description: Manifest attempts to expose assessment.quiz.submit as an agent-callable tool
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Boundary breach: User-exclusive operation QUIZ_SUBMISSION cannot be exposed as an agent tool

negative_controls.name: developer or runner tool incorrectly allowed
negative_controls.description: Tool developer.code.search is marked exposure: allowed violating coding automation boundary
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Security violation: Coding/Developer tool developer.code.search must be disabled by default

negative_controls.name: authoritative metric without registered Java source
negative_controls.description: Tool declares authoritative fact fabricated_ai_score without backend backing
negative_controls.expected_error_contains: Unverified authoritative fact 'fabricated_ai_score' has no registered Java source
